The tie at 58

Endurance vs. Say Nothing All at 58 pts

Endurance and Say Nothing both finished on 58 points — a genuine dead heat for first. The methodology calls for a Condorcet head-to-head: ignore everything else on the ballot and ask how each voter ranked these two against one another.

Head-to-head

First-place votes
Endurance 2 · Say Nothing 1

Four of seven put Endurance above Say Nothing, so Endurance takes November on the head-to-head. This is as close as our method can get without breaking: one voter switching the pair reverses the whole result. Say Nothing stays on the candidate list at full strength and starts December as the book to beat.

Notes

The tiebreaker decided the book, not a placing. Previous ties (February 2026, August 2026, the three-way in October) all landed below the winner's line or fell through to first-place votes. This one was for first, and the Condorcet head-to-head separated it cleanly on the first pass — no fall-through needed.

The winner is not a strict Condorcet winner. Endurance beats eleven of its twelve rivals head-to-head and loses only to Something Rich and Strange, 3–4 — which finished fourth on 56 points. Borda is the club's stated method, it named a winner, and the pairwise quirk is recorded here as a curiosity rather than a dispute.

Broad, not unanimous. Endurance took two first-place votes — the most in the field — and also one last-place vote. It won on being ranked high by most and buried by one, rather than on consensus. Say Nothing, by contrast, was never anyone's last choice.

Four debut books, four different fates. Endurance, Something Rich and Strange, Born to Run and Arrowsmith all appeared on a ballot for the first time. They finished first, fourth, fifth — and relegated.

The River of Doubt reaches twenty-one polls and finished tenth, one place clear of the relegation line.

Methodology

Borda count with 13 candidates: 1st place = 13 points, last place = 1 point. 7 forced-rank ballots collected via survey. Ties resolve per the club's Polling Methodology memo (formalized after the February 2026 tie): Condorcet head-to-head first, then first-place votes if pairwise cannot separate the books. This round produced a tie at 58 points, resolved by condorcet.
